name: megascenes-floor-plan
description: Draw an illustrative floor plan of a home, apartment or office from the rooms you list, or redraw a sketch from your MegaScenes library.

interface.longDescription:
List the rooms and rough sizes, say how they connect, and pick a look: clean black and white, colored, or furnished from above. Or pick a hand sketch from your MegaScenes library to redraw it cleanly.

ChatGPT tells you what the drawing needs and makes it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The floor plan opens in the chat and stays in your library.

For listings, renovation ideas, moving and presentations.

Limitations: it is a visual guide, not a construction drawing, and measurements are not guaranteed. Sketches must already be in your MegaScenes library; attachments from the chat are not passed to the plugin. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Draw a floor plan from a list of rooms
Redraw a sketch from your library cleanly
Return the floor plan in the chat
defaultPrompt: Draw a floor plan of a two bedroom apartment with an open kitchen
Make a furnished top view floor plan of a small studio flat
Redraw my latest MegaScenes sketch as a clean floor plan

positive.prompt: Which models can draw a floor plan here?
positive.expected_behavior: The floor plan models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Draw a floor plan of a two bedroom apartment with an open kitchen. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one floor plan with the default model needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which sketches do I have in my MegaScenes library?
positive.expected_behavior: The latest images of the signed-in account with their asset ids. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: Draw a floor plan of a two bedroom apartment with an open kitchen. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my floor plan on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my floor plan to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
